      0 ≤ z^2 - ((p : ℤ) + (q : ℤ) - 2) * z + (t : ℤ) + 1 := by
  intro t p q h ht z hz
  rcases h with ⟨hpp, hqq, hp4, hp18, hq4, hq18, hpq⟩
  
  have hp2 : 2 ≤ p := by
    omega
  have hq2 : 2 ≤ q := by
    omega
  have hq1 : 1 ≤ q := by
    omega
  
  have hqminus : q ≤ 2 * (q - 1) := by
    omega
  have hmul : 2 * (q - 1) ≤ p * (q - 1) := by
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right (q - 1) hp2
  have hqmul : q ≤ p * (q - 1) := by
    exact le_trans hqminus hmul
  
  have hid : p + p * (q - 1) = p * q := by
    calc
      p + p * (q - 1) = p * (1 + (q - 1)) := by ring
      _ = p * q := by
        have h : 1 + (q - 1) = q := by
          omega
        rw [h]
  
  have hsum : p + q ≤ p * q := by
    calc
      p + q ≤ p + p * (q - 1) := Nat.add_le_add_left hqmul p
      _ = p * q := hid
  
  have ht' : t + (p + q) = p * q := by
    omega
  
  have hcast : (t : ℤ) + (p : ℤ) + (q : ℤ) = (p : ℤ) * (q : ℤ) := by
    calc
      (t : ℤ) + (p : ℤ) + (q : ℤ) =
          (t : ℤ) + ((p : ℤ) + (q : ℤ)) := by ring
      _ = (p : ℤ) * (q : ℤ) := by
        exact_mod_cast ht'
  
  have hfactor :
      (t : ℤ) + 1 = ((p : ℤ) - 1) * ((q : ℤ) - 1) := by
    nlinarith [hcast]
  
  have heq :
      z^2 - ((p : ℤ) + (q : ℤ) - 2) * z + (t : ℤ) + 1 =
        (z - ((p : ℤ) - 1)) * (z - ((q : ℤ) - 1)) := by
    nlinarith [hfactor]
  
  rcases hz with hz | hz
  · have hza : z - ((p : ℤ) - 1) ≤ 0 := by
      linarith
    have hzb : z - ((q : ℤ) - 1) ≤ 0 := by
      linarith
    have hm :
        0 ≤ (z - ((p : ℤ) - 1)) * (z - ((q : ℤ) - 1)) :=
      mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos hza hzb
    rw [heq]
    exact hm
  · have hza : 0 ≤ z - ((p : ℤ) - 1) := by
      linarith
    have hzb : 0 ≤ z - ((q : ℤ) - 1) := by
      linarith
    have hm :
        0 ≤ (z - ((p : ℤ) - 1)) * (z - ((q : ℤ) - 1)) :=
      mul_nonneg hza hzb
    rw [heq]
    exact hm
